key_insight: Standard multiple-choice medical exams can make LLMs look more capable than they really are, and a harder benchmark revealed much weaker performance.
clinical_relevance: For medical AI evaluation, test design matters: bias-resistant exams may better reflect whether a model can support real clinical reasoning.
method: Expanded Polish medical exam benchmark by adding 15,000+ questions
Added two new domains and four structural changes to reduce MCQA artifacts
Evaluated 21 LLMs on both English and Polish exam settings
evidence_signal: Under the harder setup, the top model (Qwen3.5-122B) dropped by 28.4 points on English and 31 points on Polish exams, suggesting standard MCQA scores overstate competence.
watch_item: Even with low evidence of contamination, benchmark performance may still not translate to safe or reliable clinical use outside the exam format.
paper_title: Reassessing High-Performing LLMs on Polish Medical Exams: True Competence or Bias-Driven Performance?
